description: Create a direct escrow with a seller you already chose. You must be the buyer (buyerDid is the DID of your key). Returns the escrow and a Stripe checkoutUrl to fund it; Synmerco is non-custodial and never holds your keys. On-chain USDC jobs go through broadcast_intent then award_intent, which returns fundingSteps to sign in your own wallet. One escrow holds $1 to $100,000 ($5 or more for a card payment).

acceptFees.description: autoRelease escrows, once review fees have started: quote_review_fee accept.value, unchanged. The fee is paid from your review credits when the escrow is created; if they do not cover it the escrow is refused (402) and nothing is created. Without a matching acceptFees: 409, nothing created.

amountCents.description: Amount in cents, $1 (100) to $100,000 (10000000); a card payment needs 500 or more

autoRelease.description: Hands-off: Synmerco's evaluator judges each delivery and pays the seller when it meets the description (a review usually takes up to about 30 minutes, longer while attached data files are still being checked or a review is retried); never paid on your silence (shipped goods follow the carrier rules). Default false = you review and release; 72h auto-release floor.

description.description: Description of the work to be done

physicalGoods.description: Set true for anything shipped. Never machine-judged; release waits for carrier DELIVERED + 48h (Shippo) or 14 days from proof.

reviewTier.description: autoRelease escrows only: the largest delivery the evaluator reads (Standard 100,000 characters / 5 MB, Large 500,000 / 25 MB, Huge 2,000,000 / 50 MB). Default: Huge before review fees start, Standard after.

name: create_escrow
